placements.title: owned intelligence retains what rented intelligence commodifies
placements.frame: What does an intelligence owner retain that a renter does not, and how does that distinction reframe substrate versus perspective?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 carry the same constitutive thesis — owned vs rented intelligence, substrate as commodity, perspective as the retained asset — performed as axiomatic principle across every dimensional read. No existing leaf or strata holds this. The grain test admits it: this names a subject (the individually-owned-intelligence thesis) that future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact or measurement.
